description: This file defines the class `TaxClass` that manages localisation tax classes in the OpenCart admin system. It includes methods for listing, viewing, creating, editing, and saving tax class data, and integrates with models and views accordingly.

classes.name: TaxClass
classes.description: Controller class for managing tax classes in the localisation section of the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the list of tax classes with sorting, pagination, and navigation breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to retrieve and display the list of tax classes.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Provides the HTML view for the list of tax classes, including sorting and pagination links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a tax class.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the form submission to add or update a tax class, returning JSON response with success or error messages.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles the deletion of selected tax classes, including permission checks and response with success/error messages.
